title: A muted DM with an unread mention stays quiet: grey count, muted name
why: Muted is the only thing that makes a DM quiet, and nothing pierces it: a mention (or following) does not make a muted DM loud; its count is grey and its name muted. Decided by artin (#proj-mobile:966d7abd, 2026-10-29): web's behaviour.

knownGaps.reason: adopt decision (artin 10-29): the app makes a muted DM loud when a mention pierces the mute or the DM is followed.
